episodes.synopsis: In a town blanketed by snow, a place from his distant childhood, Yuichi reconnects with his cousin Nayuki. As she gives him a tour of his new home, he struggles with memories long faded.
episodes.title: Silver Overture

episodes.synopsis: After his first day at school, Yuichi is able to stir the memories of Ayu, who happily recalls a promise he made to her years before. But the strange girl who later attacks Yuichi doesn’t seem happy at all.
episodes.title: Introit in the Snow

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi’s attacker claims to have amnesia, and with the gaps in his own recollections and Ayu’s forgetfulness, Yuichi starts to think the town might somehow alter people’s memories.
episodes.title: A Forgotten Partita

episodes.synopsis: Ayu still can’t locate what she’s looking for, but Yuichi knows where he left Nayuki’s notes: at the school. When he goes retrieve them, he finds he’s not alone in the hallways - and the other person is armed.
episodes.title: Holiday Caprice

episodes.synopsis: Mai explains why she’s at the school with a sword. The next day, Yuichi sees her almost use it on Makoto! When the incident ends, Mai offers Yuichi a bit of odd advice on how to handle the amnesiac.
episodes.title: Demons' Serenade

episodes.synopsis: Makoto has an appointment to interview for a job at a café. Meanwhile, another encounter with Shiori makes Yuichi late for his movie date with Ayu.
episodes.title: A Mysterious Divertimento

episodes.synopsis: Makoto’s carelessness with a kitten causes Yuichi to lash out. Unfortunately, Makoto’s response to his anger is to run away. Later, Mai somehow directs him to her likely location.
episodes.title: Fugue of a Runaway Kitten

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi finds his feelings for Makoto growing, and his memory offers clues of who she might really be. Meanwhile, a girl named Mishio offers him startling information about Makoto - and a strange warning.
episodes.title: Fantasia of Reminiscence

episodes.synopsis: Makoto is growing weaker, leading Yuichi to increase the amount of attention he gives her. Her condition grave, Yuichi recalls Mishio’s words - and he also remembers a fuller picture of Makoto’s past.
episodes.title: The Berceuse of the Baby Fox

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi and Makoto spend a personal moment alone atop a special hill. As she tragically seems to slowly slip away from this world, his only focus is on making sure her wishes come true.
episodes.title: Requiem atop the Hill

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi discovers Mai’s bad reputation; she has a history of being blamed any time something bad happens on campus. Hoping to help her fix her image, Yuichi invites her to the school dance.
episodes.title: Intermezzo of Light and a Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi’s plan to salvage Mai’s reputation seems to be working! With him in a tux and her looking radiant in her dress, nothing could ruin the school dance - except maybe the sudden appearance of a demon.
episodes.title: A Grotesque Waltz

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi’s eager to defend Mai after her outburst at the dance, but someone beats him to it. His chance to play the hero dashed, Yuichi turns his attention to convincing Mai he’s brave enough to fight alongside her.
episodes.title: A Dangerous Trio

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi is throttled by Mai’s revelation that the demons might come after him next. Sayuri is worried about both of her friends, but an attempt to surprise Mai on her birthday could end disastrously!
episodes.title: Cracked Concerto

episodes.synopsis: After fighting their way to the last demon, Mai mysteriously disappears and Yuichi is floored by an invisible force that conjures up visions of the past - and reveals a shocking secret! During the
episodes.title: Sonatina of Hide-and-Seek

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi decides it’s time to make good on his promise to Shiori. The two friends enjoy a day of snowball fights and whack-a-mole, but Yuichi’s evening is marred by tragic revelations.
episodes.title: Midnight Oratorio

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi desperately wants to make Shiori’s birthday special, but he can’t seem to think of how - until a chat with Ayu provides just the right inspiration.
episodes.title: Lieder Ohne Worte of an Elder Sister and a Younger Sister

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to make her final days special, Yuichi hatches a plan to surprise Shiori with a birthday party on the day before her birthday! But there’s one thing he must do first - convince Kaori to attend the party.
episodes.title: The Disappearing Adagio

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi sees Nayuki in a different light when the final track meet rolls around. Later on, Ayu and Yuichi’s search for the all-important missing item leads to something very special.
episodes.title: Étude of Contact

episodes.synopsis: Still basking in the glow of their kiss, Yuichi and Ayu spend more and more time together. Everything appears to be going splendidly - until their burgeoning romance is derailed by a visit to Ayu’s school.
episodes.title: Nocturne of Separation

episodes.synopsis: Ayu’s disappearance prompts Yuichi to search even more diligently for her missing item. Nayuki goes out of her way to cheer up her heartsick housemate, but she my regret requesting strawberry cake.
episodes.title: A Rondo Without You

episodes.synopsis: Grief-stricken Nayuki locks herself in her room and refuses to let anyone enter. Tragic memories concerning Ayu wash over Yuichi, causing him to wander into the woods during a snowstorm.
episodes.title: Symphony of Recollection

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi is rescued by Makoto - who offers him some encouraging words. Meanwhile, Kaori tries to help Nayuki deal with her mother’s accident. And finally, Yuichi is reunited with Ayu - at least temporarily.
episodes.title: The Scarlet Red Finale

episodes.synopsis: Yuichi is still searching for Ayu. Akiko may hold the key to discovering her whereabouts, but will Yuichi be able to handle the truth about her current condition?
episodes.title: Kanon at the End of a Dream
